properties.statement: An import registry merge appends an unseen declaration at the end of the effective sequence.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (code name : String) (earlier : Esm.Rewrite.Imports.Entries) (value : Esm.Document.Json), earlier.lookup name = none → Esm.Rewrite.Imports.mergeEntries code earlier [(name, value)] = .ok (earlier ++ [(name, value)])

properties.statement: A deep-equal duplicate keeps the registry intact, including the earlier declaration’s position.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (code name : String) (earlier : Esm.Rewrite.Imports.Entries) (previous value : Esm.Document.Json), earlier.lookup name = some previous → Esm.Rewrite.sameValue previous value = true → Esm.Rewrite.Imports.mergeEntries code earlier [(name, value)] = .ok earlier

properties.statement: An import edge maps every axis in a shape constraint through its axis rename, preserving the order and the parameter constrained.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (mapping : Esm.Rewrite.Imports.Renames) (param : String) (axes : List String), Esm.Rewrite.Imports.renameWhere mapping (.obj [(param, .obj [("shape", .arr (axes.map Esm.Document.Json.str))])]) = .obj [(param, .obj [("shape", .arr ((axes.map (Esm.Rewrite.Imports.renamed mapping)).map Esm.Document.Json.str))])]
